# A research item with no tracker and no forge. The command is obeereal, the real composition root.
# The only programs on PATH are the fake claude, git, sh and the small tools of the check. There is no bd and no gh.
# The scope agent writes six sub-questions and the workflow keeps five. The research agent writes one notes file for each, the check passes,
# a summary agent writes the summary, the first review approves the notes and the summary, and the report step writes the report into the folder out.
isolate
exec git --version
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

# The files of examples/research are the files of the example, with no change. The project has no repository, so the work folder of the item is a plain folder.
example research/workflow.star
example research/project.star config/projects/research.star
example research/prompts/scope.md
example research/prompts/research.md
example research/prompts/review.md
example research/prompts/revise.md
example research/prompts/conclude.md
example research/tools/check.sh
example research/tools/report.sh
fakeclaude
serve

env RESEARCH_TOOLS=$WORK/research/tools
env RESEARCH_OUT=$WORK/out

exec obeereal check workflow research/workflow.star
! stdout .
! stderr .

exec obeereal item add research weigh-ab --title 'Compare A and B' --body-file body.txt
stdout 'added item weigh-ab to project research'

exec obeereal run weigh-ab research --workflow research/workflow.star
stdout 'item weigh-ab finished'

exec obeereal status
stdout 'weigh-ab-r1\tdone'

# The steps ran in order: the scope, one research step for each of the first five sub-questions and none for the sixth, the summary, one review.
cmp calls.log expected-calls.log

# The report starts with the summary, then holds the notes and the list of sources, and no open findings.
grep '^# Compare A and B$' out/weigh-ab.md
grep '^## Summary$' out/weigh-ab.md
grep '^A and B are compared in the notes\.$' out/weigh-ab.md
grep '^# What is A\?$' out/weigh-ab.md
grep '^# What is E\?$' out/weigh-ab.md
! grep 'What is F' out/weigh-ab.md
grep '^## Sources$' out/weigh-ab.md
grep -count=1 '^- http://127.0.0.1:[0-9]+/ok$' out/weigh-ab.md
! grep 'Open findings' out/weigh-ab.md
! exists out/weigh-ab-unreviewed.md

-- body.txt --
Compare A and B.
-- six --
-- verdicts --
approve
-- expected-calls.log --
scope
research 1
research 2
research 3
research 4
research 5
summary
review
